constructor
· rintro ⟨ε, hε, h⟩
  linarith
· intro h
  exact ⟨classicalRate δ - binaryRate δ, by linarith, by linarith⟩
parsed.english: The asymptotic binary code rate at relative distance δ is strictly less than the classical rate bound at δ.
parsed.why_clearer: The existential gap ε is just a disguised strict inequality, so it reads directly as binaryRate δ < classicalRate δ.
